def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits within 8 bits; the high k bits wrap around to the low end."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    post k != 0 or out == x
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(255, 3) == 255
    ex rotl8(90, 0) == 90
    s = (8 - k) % 8
    hi = x >> s
    rest = x - (hi << s)
    return (rest << k) | hi
